player.unsupportedTitle: Preview not available in your browser
player.unsupportedBody: This tape is encoded in HEVC (H.265), which most browsers can't play. The AI analysis still ran on it — convert it for in-browser playback, or download the original.
player.converting: Converting for playback… this can take a few minutes. The player will refresh automatically when it's ready.
player.convertFailed: Conversion failed. You can retry, or download the original to watch it.
player.convertedUnsupported: The converted copy still can't be previewed here. Please download it to watch.
player.convertError: Couldn't start the conversion. Please try again in a moment.

about.title: About the Project
about.description: This project is a sample .Net 8.0 web API with React and Docker support project for demonstration purposes and as a starting point for a fullstack application. It demonstrates the use of .Net 8.0 SDK, React, Docker, and Nginx for creating a development and production environment for web applications.
